concept.dimension_basis: Component dimensions are axis-aligned bounding extents in assembled model coordinates, rounded to 0.0001 mm from package-measurement.json; they include protrusions and are not printing tolerances. Overall envelope is rounded to 0.1 mm. Full-size package values are design assumptions at nominal 1:12 scale.
concept.interaction: Remove the upright motorcycle from its belly cradle, guide it upright while its two captured wheels roll, and replace it on the stand. Steering and suspension are fixed.

novel_mechanisms.definition: Ordinary freely rotating model wheels on stationary purchased M 3 axles, with plain jam nut pairs. Locally declared because this packet contains no vault snapshot; not a claim of patent novelty.
A removable belly cradle supports the motorcycle upright on a broad display base. Locally declared because the host supplied no vault snapshot, not because the ordinary mechanism is new.

concept.print_stance: Individual component entries return bed-normalized print stances; mirror-specific entries for asymmetric chassis, swingarm, bridge and saddle halves.
concept.summary: Unofficial 2050 interpretation of the user’s Harley Davidson Heritage Classic brief: low touring cruiser, deep fenders, saddlebags and windshield around a new electric package.

technology_ledger.assumption: 24 kWh battery in 69.69 L at 96 kg
technology_ledger.rationale: 344 Wh/L gross and 250 Wh/kg pack target; DOE research is directional evidence, not production proof

technology_ledger.assumption: Visible V cooling shoulders serve liquid-cooled electric pack
technology_ledger.rationale: Physically plausible heat exchanger placement; thermal performance not assessed

technology_ledger.assumption: Conventional central motor belt drive and mechanical steering
technology_ledger.rationale: No hub motor, autonomy or nonphysical motion; scale model contains no electrical loads

design_changes.change: Split asymmetric mirrored halves into individual print entries.

Meets fork inner faces without overlap while maintaining 3.2 mm radial clearance.

design_changes.change: Represent motor as radius 10 x 24 mm housing at X-32 Z 39.
design_changes.reason: Preserves rear energy-package region and clears rear tyre; a future packaging assumption.

design_changes.change: Full-footprint tank lower sections at Z 49, 50 and 52; constant projected tank clearance through each saddle half.
design_changes.reason: Removes unsupported lower tank and saddle nose growth while preserving the teardrop dome and stepped seating.

design_changes.change: Leave pannier print-bed perimeter unchamfered; retain upper edge treatment.
design_changes.reason: Removes the initial unsupported perimeter overhang.

design_changes.change: Route the chassis neck forward, start its housing at X 29.5, and raise its top to Z 71.2.
design_changes.reason: Clears the tank and vertical assembly path while preserving a 2 mm roof above the steering socket.

design_changes.change: Open steering socket through X 40.2; extend root pocket to X -22.3; subtract exact saddle and enlarged swingarm profiles from both chassis halves.
design_changes.reason: Removes assembly intrusions. Swingarm relief reaches through the outer frame face to avoid a thin unsupported residual cap.

design_changes.change: Reconcile all component dimensions to current assembled CAD bounds, including screen tongue, luggage bosses and cooling ribs. Overall envelope is 204.3978 by 77.5 by 118 mm including the stand.
design_changes.reason: Earlier proposal dimensions described partial features or pre-repair geometry. Full-size dimensions remain assumed design targets, not measurements of a manufactured vehicle.

measured_geometry.source: Root measured canonical STEP during bounded repair; analytic bore has no helical thread

hardware.purpose: Two ordinary full-height plain M3 nuts per bolt form the proposed jam pair; they are not thin jam nuts. Canonical geometry measured 2.4 mm thickness and 1.5 mm bore radius. Actual thread engagement, tightening and retention remain physically untested.
